name: EPIC 213690825

text.card: A red giant 5,721 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.92 solar masses and 14.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,714 K at its surface.
